A 30-year-old male presents to the office with a chief complaint of chronic lower back pain. The patient
does not remember injuring his back but he states he does a lot of heavy lifting at his job. Nonsteroidal
anti-inflammatory medications have only minimally alleviated his pain. On exam, there is tenderness
over the lumbosacral region with a reduced lordotic curve. Seated and standing flexion tests reveal no
abnormalities. The sacral base is posterior bilaterally. There is movement restriction at the lumbosacral
junction with anterior force. The flexion and extension of the sacrum during cranial rhythmic impulse
are unremarkable. The straight leg test is negative and the rest of the examination is unremarkable.
What is the most likely diagnosis? Answer Choices: (A) Bilateral sacral torsion along the middle
transverse axis (B) Unilateral sacral flexion along the middle transverse axis (C) Bilateral sacral flexion
along the middle transverse axis (D) Bilateral sacral extension along the superior transverse axis (E)
Bilateral sacral rotation along the middle transverse axis (F) Bilateral sacral extension along the middle
transverse axis (G) Sacral base anterior with restriction along the superior transverse axis (H) Bilateral
sacral extension along the inferior transverse axis (I) Bilateral sacral flexion along the superior
transverse axis (J) Bilateral sacral flexion along the inferior transverse axis
 A. Bilateral sacral flexion along the inferior transverse axis
B. Bilateral sacral extension along the inferior transverse axis
C. Bilateral sacral rotation along the middle transverse axis
D. Bilateral sacral extension along the middle transverse axis
E. Sacral base anterior with restriction along the superior transverse axis
F. Bilateral sacral extension along the superior transverse axis
G. Unilateral sacral flexion along the middle transverse axis
H. Bilateral sacral flexion along the middle transverse axis
I. Bilateral sacral flexion along the superior transverse axis
J. Bilateral sacral torsion along the middle transverse axis
